decisions.reason: The source message directly reinforces liquid separation from electrical components, but the candidate already has a complete same-message MODIFY extending its scope to FOOD_SERVICE; no additional update or removal is required.
Maintenance and replacement access is already represented by the candidate's existing attributes and its same-message scope extension to FOOD_SERVICE.
Simple whisk removal for cleaning was already required, and the existing same-message MODIFY fully records the retail food-service context without changing the removal behavior.

Food-safe contact materials are established by a separate clause in the same source message and are already represented by the candidate's INTRODUCE Event; the dispensing-path sanitation change adds nothing further.
CAD-file retention is a separate documentation request already captured by the candidate's same-message MODIFY and is not changed by the dispensing-path sanitation requirements.
Preventing concealed liquid traps and enabling sanitation do not modify the existing requirement that the spout connection remain leak-free.
The sanitation and liquid-trap provisions do not change the dispensing control mechanism, sequence, flow behavior, or operator controls.
The source decision concerns sanitation access and trapped-liquid prevention, not spout mounting, orientation, material, appearance, or pour direction.
Dispensing-path sanitation does not alter the platform's height, footprint, or cup-clearance purpose.
Cleaning access and prevention of concealed liquid traps do not change mixing quality, foam performance, whisk geometry, selection, or positioning.
Sanitation access for the dispensing path does not modify the separate requirement to control splashing during mixing.
The source does not require a BOM revision or change any currently selected component; its documentation and material questions do not necessarily alter this deliverable.
